facts.content: Patient had transient diarrhea at onset, which has resolved.

facts.content: For viral URTI: rest, increase fluids, take paracetamol as needed, off work for 1 to 2 days.
facts.source_text: Viral URTI: rest, ↑fluids, paracetamol PRN; off work 1–2 d

facts.content: Return if no improvement or worsening of symptoms like fever or increased cough/SOB in 2 to 3 days, consider CXR and possibly antibiotics.
facts.source_text: return if no improvement or worsening (fever, ↑cough/SOB) in 2–3 d → consider CXR ± antibiotics

facts.content: Continue Metformin for Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and routine follow-up with PCP.
facts.source_text: T2DM: continue metformin; routine PCP follow-up

facts.content: Continue Lisinopril for hypertension and monitor blood pressure at home.
facts.source_text: HTN: continue lisinopril; home BP monitoring

facts.content: Reinforce smoking cessation and advise to taper wine consumption to 2 glasses per week, aiming for abstinence.
facts.source_text: Lifestyle: reinforce smoking cessation; taper wine to ≤2 glasses/wk, aim for abstinence
